diagnostic_questions.opening_framing: Before I throw a bunch of ideas at you, I'd rather understand how the business actually operates and where the friction is. That way I can be specific about what would actually help instead of pitching a generic AI menu.

questions.question: Walk me through your catering process. From inquiry to event execution. Where does it bottleneck?
What percent of your transactions are through the Joe Coffee app vs walk-in? Are you happy with that ratio?
How are you currently asking customers for reviews? Is it systematic or organic?
questions.why: Easy ROI win if not systematized

questions.question: How do you currently track what's happening at both locations? What would you want to see in one view?
If you wanted to email all your regulars tomorrow about a new menu launch, could you do it? How would you reach them?
Who handles your social and how much time does that eat per week?
When someone inquires about catering, what happens? How long does it take you to respond? How many inquiries don't convert?
What tools are you using today? POS, scheduling, marketing, accounting, online ordering?
questions.why: Avoids redundant proposals, finds integration opportunities

questions.question: If you could free up 5 hours a week, what would you spend it on?
What does Hallowed Grounds look like in 24 months? Three locations? More catering? Wholesale? Helps me understand what to build toward.
questions.why: Frames you as long-term partner, not vendor
